## Verification

- [ ] `make verify`
- [ ] `make smoke`
- [ ] `make race` for concurrency/store changes
- [ ] Added or updated fixtures/evals
- [ ] No secrets or customer data
- [ ] Security boundaries reviewed
- [ ] Documentation and rollback updated

## Evidence

Include test output, sanitized artifacts, screenshots, or evaluation results. Do not include live credentials or unauthorized target data.
